exclusions.source_text: Have a performance status of 0 or 1 on the ECOG Performance Scale (see Appendix A).
Be ≥18 years of age on the day of signing informed consent.
Serum creatinine ≤1.5x ULN or creatinine clearance ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m2 for participants with creatinine levels above 1.5x ULN
exclusions.threshold: creatinine ≤1.5x ULN or CrCl ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m2

exclusions.source_text: Total bilirubin ≤ upper limit of normal (ULN)
AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) ≤2.5x institutional ULN (or ≤1.5x institutional ULN if concomitant with alkaline phosphatase \>2.5x institutional ULN) or ≤5x ULN for those with liver metastases
exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT ≤2.5x ULN (≤5x ULN with liver metastases)

exclusions.source_text: Subjects who are pregnant, or breastfeeding, or expecting to conceive or father children within the projected duration of the trial
Participant has known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.
Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or requires active treatment.
Patients with HIV are eligible if their plasma HIV viral load is undetectable at baseline on antiretroviral therapy.
evidence of symptomatic congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, stroke, or ventricular arrhythmia within 6 months of enrollment.
